defaults.logs: vimax_mission_events / vimax_ai_calls (hosted) or local companion log (local)

agents.name: CEO Orchestrator Agent
agents.responsibility: Set channel mission objectives, authorise plans and require human sign-off before anything public
agents.success_criteria: mission row created with stages and approval flag

agents.name: Task Decomposition Agent
agents.responsibility: Break an approved objective into ordered, independently testable mission stages
agents.success_criteria: every stage lists inputs, outputs and owner

agents.name: Workflow Planning Agent
agents.responsibility: Order stages so dependencies resolve before side effects and retries stay idempotent
agents.success_criteria: workflow validates with no cyclic dependencies

agents.name: Agent Assignment Agent
agents.responsibility: Map each stage to exactly one registered agent with the required tool permissions
agents.success_criteria: each stage maps to one agent id from the registry

agents.name: Dependency Management Agent
agents.responsibility: Track cross-stage inputs and block downstream stages until artefacts exist
agents.success_criteria: blocked stage never runs before its input artefact

agents.name: Budget and Cost Control Agent
agents.responsibility: Enforce per-user and shared daily attempt budgets before new provider calls
agents.success_criteria: call rejected server-side once daily attempts exhausted

agents.name: Priority Management Agent
agents.responsibility: Reorder queued missions by owner priority without violating dependencies
agents.success_criteria: priority change does not break stage ordering

agents.name: Progress Monitoring Agent
agents.responsibility: Summarise live mission stage states, lease health and failure counts
agents.success_criteria: report matches stage rows and events exactly

agents.name: Failure Recovery Agent
agents.responsibility: Classify failed stages, apply bounded retries and mark ambiguous outcomes uncertain
agents.success_criteria: no automatic replay of ambiguous billable calls

agents.name: Final Quality Approval Agent
agents.responsibility: Verify the artefact checklist of a finished mission and hold it for owner approval
agents.success_criteria: mission stays awaiting-approval until owner acts

agents.name: Niche Discovery Agent
agents.responsibility: Propose channel niches from owner inputs using structured scoring, never invented demand data
agents.success_criteria: each option carries a scored rationale string

agents.name: Market Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Collect owner-provided market notes into the channel profile; no fabricated market figures
agents.success_criteria: profile stores cited owner-supplied notes only

agents.name: Competitor Analysis Agent
agents.responsibility: Maintain the owner-curated competitor URL list and snapshot what the owner pastes
agents.success_criteria: only owner-approved URLs stored with timestamps

agents.name: Audience Persona Agent
agents.responsibility: Draft audience personas from owner research and record the source of every claim
agents.success_criteria: persona fields mark unverified assumptions

agents.name: Channel Name Generator Agent
agents.responsibility: Generate name candidates and lint each for length, readability and duplication risks
agents.success_criteria: every candidate passes title lint or is flagged

agents.name: Brand Identity Agent
agents.responsibility: Record brand voice, tone and visual rules in the channel profile for downstream agents
agents.success_criteria: brand rules consumed by script and packaging stages

agents.name: Channel Description Agent
agents.responsibility: Draft a channel description within YouTube limits with honest positioning
agents.success_criteria: description within limits and free of guaranteed-outcome claims

agents.name: Channel Keywords Agent
agents.responsibility: Compile channel keywords from niche and description without keyword-stuffing
agents.success_criteria: keyword list under limit and deduplicated

agents.name: Channel Banner and Logo Agent
agents.responsibility: Prepare banner/logo briefs and track generation once an image provider is configured
agents.gated_by: image generation provider not configured; ComfyUI requires GPU hardware
agents.success_criteria: brief stored; render marked unavailable until provider added

agents.name: Channel Setup Checklist Agent
agents.responsibility: Assemble the owner-action checklist for steps the YouTube API cannot perform
agents.success_criteria: checklist separates API-done items from owner-manual items

agents.name: YouTube Trend Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Fetch YouTube trending or topic data once an authorised data source is connected
agents.success_criteria: snapshot cites source and time or reports unavailable

agents.name: Google Trends Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Read Google Trends through a configured research provider only
agents.gated_by: web research provider not integrated (SearXNG/crawl4ai pending)
agents.success_criteria: no trend numbers without a fetched source

agents.name: Search Demand Analysis Agent
agents.responsibility: Compute demand signals from owner-supplied or fetched query data with provenance
agents.success_criteria: every demand value links to a source URL or is marked estimated

agents.name: Competitor Video Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Organise competitor video metadata the owner exports; no scraping of private data
agents.success_criteria: matrix built only from owner-supplied exports

agents.name: Topic Scoring Agent
agents.responsibility: Score topic candidates with the local idea heuristic and record advisory bands
agents.success_criteria: each candidate has a stored score with advisory notice

agents.name: Audience Question Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Collect real audience questions from owner-provided comments and searches
agents.success_criteria: questions retain their original source text

agents.name: Evergreen Topic Agent
agents.responsibility: Flag topics as evergreen only against stored evidence, not by assertion
agents.success_criteria: evergreen flag includes supporting note

agents.name: News Verification Agent
agents.responsibility: Mark time-sensitive claims as requiring current-source verification by the owner
agents.success_criteria: no news claim passes without a source or explicit flag

agents.name: Fact-Checking Agent
agents.responsibility: Inventory factual claims in drafts and require sources before they are stated as fact
agents.success_criteria: unsourced claims are flagged, never asserted

agents.name: Topic Selection Agent
agents.responsibility: Choose the final topic by combining scores, evergreen status and verification flags
agents.success_criteria: selection rationale stored with the chosen topic

agents.name: Video Outline Agent
agents.responsibility: Build a beat-by-beat outline from the selected topic inside the target duration
agents.success_criteria: outline has ordered beats with time budgets

agents.name: Long-Form Script Agent
agents.responsibility: Draft the full narration script stage of the mission queue for owner review
agents.success_criteria: script stored as a mission step artefact

agents.name: Shorts Script Agent
agents.responsibility: Draft a compressed Shorts script with a hook inside the first seconds
agents.success_criteria: shorts script under target duration with early hook

agents.name: Storytelling Agent
agents.responsibility: Apply narrative structure of setup, tension and payoff to outline revisions
agents.success_criteria: beats map to narrative roles explicitly

agents.name: Hook and Opening Agent
agents.responsibility: Generate hook variants and score each with the local hook heuristic before selection
agents.success_criteria: at least two scored hook variants stored with panels

agents.name: Retention Optimization Agent
agents.responsibility: Read owner-provided retention exports to locate leaks and suggest script fixes
agents.success_criteria: findings cite timestamps from the export

agents.name: Educational Content Agent
agents.responsibility: Restructure drafts into teaching sequences with checks for understanding
agents.success_criteria: each concept has an example and a recap

agents.name: Documentary Script Agent
agents.responsibility: Assemble sourced narrative scripts that separate fact from interpretation
agents.success_criteria: every factual segment carries a source note

agents.name: Dialogue and Narration Agent
agents.responsibility: Adapt scripts to spoken-word rhythm and mark pronunciation risk words
agents.success_criteria: filler rate and sentence lengths recorded

agents.name: Script Originality and Quality Agent
agents.responsibility: Run originality and quality checks against competitor material the owner supplies
agents.success_criteria: report flags imitation risk and requires owner sign-off

agents.name: Storyboard Agent
agents.responsibility: Convert approved scripts into shot lists with an on-screen description per beat
agents.gated_by: local companion dependencies not installed (Piper/FFmpeg/python env)
agents.success_criteria: every beat has an on-screen description

agents.name: Scene Planning Agent
agents.responsibility: Plan scene order, durations and transitions against the storyboard
agents.success_criteria: scene durations sum to target runtime

agents.name: AI Image Generation Agent
agents.responsibility: Generate visuals through a configured provider only; never fake output
agents.gated_by: image and video providers not configured; ComfyUI needs GPU, Runpod needs key plus flag
agents.success_criteria: provider availability confirmed before promising images

agents.name: AI Video Generation Agent
agents.responsibility: Request optional GPU clip previews with cost display and approval before spend
agents.success_criteria: no job without enabled flag, key and owner approval

agents.name: Stock Footage Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Search Pexels once a key is configured and record licence terms per asset
agents.success_criteria: each candidate stores URL, owner and licence

agents.name: Stock Image Research Agent
agents.responsibility: Source still images from configured free providers with licence capture
agents.success_criteria: licence metadata present for every candidate

agents.name: Visual Asset Licensing Agent
agents.responsibility: Maintain the licence register and block assets whose terms are unknown
agents.success_criteria: asset without known licence cannot reach render

agents.name: B-Roll Selection Agent
agents.responsibility: Match B-roll candidates to script beats and mark unmatched beats for fill
agents.success_criteria: every beat has B-roll or an explicit gap flag

agents.name: Animation Agent
agents.responsibility: Produce motion and transition specs for the renderer from the scene plan
agents.gated_by: local companion dependencies not installed; GPU providers unavailable
agents.success_criteria: specs reference renderer-supported effects only

agents.name: Visual Continuity Agent
agents.responsibility: Check style consistency across shots using stored style rules and reports
agents.success_criteria: style violations listed with shot references

agents.name: Text-to-Speech Agent
agents.responsibility: Produce voiceovers with the configured local TTS engine after verifying availability
agents.gated_by: Piper and Kokoro not installed here; svai TTS edge function pending security hardening
agents.success_criteria: audio generated only when engine present, else marked unavailable

agents.name: Voice Selection Agent
agents.responsibility: Select among browser voices with language fit and record the chosen voice id
agents.success_criteria: selection limited to voices actually available on the device

agents.name: Pronunciation Correction Agent
agents.responsibility: Flag risky words and store phonetic hints for the TTS input
agents.success_criteria: every flagged word has a stored hint

agents.name: Voice Timing Agent
agents.responsibility: Estimate runtime at 150 words per minute and warn when script exceeds target duration
agents.success_criteria: runtime estimate stored before rendering

agents.name: Background Music Agent
agents.responsibility: Attach music only from sources with recorded licences; keep music optional
agents.success_criteria: track without licence record blocks the step

agents.name: Sound Effects Agent
agents.responsibility: Plan SFX cues against beats using only cleared libraries
agents.success_criteria: each cue references a cleared source or is dropped

agents.name: Audio Cleanup Agent
agents.responsibility: Schedule noise reduction and cleanup passes in the local render pipeline
agents.success_criteria: cleanup settings logged with the artefact

agents.name: Loudness Normalization Agent
agents.responsibility: Normalize loudness to YouTube targets inside the render step
agents.success_criteria: measured loudness within target range

agents.name: Music Licensing Verification Agent
agents.responsibility: Verify and store licence text for every audio asset before use
agents.success_criteria: missing licence proof holds the asset

agents.name: Audio Quality Agent
agents.responsibility: Inspect final audio for clipping, sync drift and silence anomalies
agents.success_criteria: report lists defects with timestamps

agents.name: Long-Form Editor Agent
agents.responsibility: Assemble long-form timelines from approved scene and audio artefacts
agents.success_criteria: assembly completes with approved assets only

agents.name: Shorts Editor Agent
agents.responsibility: Assemble vertical 9 by 16 Shorts cuts with early-hook pacing
agents.success_criteria: output matches Shorts aspect and duration targets

agents.name: Scene Assembly Agent
agents.responsibility: Stitch scenes with transitions and keep the frame timeline continuous
agents.success_criteria: stitched timeline passes duration checks

agents.name: Subtitle Synchronization Agent
agents.responsibility: Generate SRT or VTT from transcript timing and verify cue alignment
agents.success_criteria: cue offsets validated against audio

agents.name: Automatic Caption Agent
agents.responsibility: Transcribe audio locally with Whisper-family models when installed
agents.success_criteria: captions produced only from real audio

agents.name: Vertical Reframing Agent
agents.responsibility: Reframe 16:9 sources to 9:16 with subject-safe cropping rules
agents.success_criteria: reframe keeps subject within safe area

agents.name: Transition and Motion Graphics Agent
agents.responsibility: Apply approved transitions and reject decorative motion that harms retention
agents.success_criteria: transition list stored with rationale

agents.name: Color and Image Quality Agent
agents.responsibility: Run colour and exposure checks and record corrective filters per shot
agents.success_criteria: no shot silently exceeds luma limits

agents.name: FFmpeg Rendering Agent
agents.responsibility: Execute the bounded FFmpeg render for approved inputs with logged settings
agents.gated_by: local companion dependencies not installed (imageio-ffmpeg exists only in companion env)
agents.success_criteria: render exits zero with matching audio and video duration

agents.name: Final Video Inspection Agent
agents.responsibility: Verify container duration, streams, resolution and checksum before approval
agents.success_criteria: report must pass every hard check

agents.name: Thumbnail Concept Agent
agents.responsibility: Draft thumbnail concepts tied to the title and hook promise
agents.success_criteria: concepts consistent with title promise

agents.name: Thumbnail Image Generation Agent
agents.responsibility: Render thumbnails via configured image provider or local tool when available
agents.gated_by: image provider not configured; GPU unavailable
agents.success_criteria: no thumbnail claimed without an actual image file

agents.name: Thumbnail Text Agent
agents.responsibility: Shorten thumbnail text to readable limits and lint contrast rules
agents.success_criteria: text within mobile readability limit

agents.name: Thumbnail Composition Agent
agents.responsibility: Compose final thumbnail layout with brand rules and safe margins
agents.gated_by: image tooling not available in this environment
agents.success_criteria: composed file passes dimension checks

agents.name: Title Generation Agent
agents.responsibility: Generate title variants and lint each against the paired thumbnail
agents.success_criteria: top variants linted as pairings, not standalone

agents.name: Title Variant Testing Agent
agents.responsibility: Rank title variants by lint results and record why each ranks where it does
agents.success_criteria: ranking includes stored lint evidence

agents.name: Description Writing Agent
agents.responsibility: Draft the description with hook, timestamps and honest claims only
agents.success_criteria: description within limits and no invented links

agents.name: Chapters and Timestamps Agent
agents.responsibility: Generate validated chapter marks that will render on YouTube
agents.success_criteria: chapters pass YouTube rendering rules or are marked invalid

agents.name: Tags and Hashtags Agent
agents.responsibility: Build tag sets within YouTube limits, deduplicated and niche-relevant
agents.success_criteria: tags under 500 characters and unique

agents.name: Metadata Validation Agent
agents.responsibility: Validate the final metadata bundle against platform limits and policy checks
agents.success_criteria: bundle passes validation before upload stage

agents.name: Upload Preparation Agent
agents.responsibility: Assemble the upload payload with private privacy and idempotency keys
agents.success_criteria: payload hashed for duplicate prevention

agents.name: YouTube OAuth and Permission Agent
agents.responsibility: Manage per-channel consent, scope checks and encrypted grant storage
agents.success_criteria: grant verified against allowlist before any upload

agents.name: Channel Destination Verification Agent
agents.responsibility: Confirm the target channel id matches the selected connection before upload
agents.success_criteria: mismatched destination blocks the upload

agents.name: Video Upload Agent
agents.responsibility: Execute resumable upload with progress, retry and cancellation
agents.success_criteria: video_id recorded or failure stored with retry state

agents.name: Playlist Management Agent
agents.responsibility: Add uploaded videos to owner-defined playlists through the official API
agents.success_criteria: playlist changes limited to owner-approved lists

agents.name: Publishing Schedule Agent
agents.responsibility: Schedule publication times via mission not_before after approval
agents.success_criteria: nothing public without recorded approval

agents.name: Subtitle Upload Agent
agents.responsibility: Attach subtitle files through the API where supported
agents.success_criteria: caption upload result recorded honestly

agents.name: Thumbnail Upload Agent
agents.responsibility: Set custom thumbnails through the API after approval
agents.success_criteria: thumbnail change only on approved video

agents.name: Upload Status Verification Agent
agents.responsibility: Poll upload and processing state until terminal, with timeout
agents.success_criteria: terminal states reached or reported stuck

agents.name: Publishing Error Recovery Agent
agents.responsibility: Classify upload failures and require review before expensive retries
agents.success_criteria: no duplicate uploads after ambiguous failures

agents.name: YouTube Analytics Agent
agents.responsibility: Fetch authorised channel metrics when analytics flag and consent are enabled
agents.success_criteria: metrics labelled confirmed versus unavailable

agents.name: Click-Through Rate Analysis Agent
agents.responsibility: Analyse CTR from real analytics or owner-pasted stats, else report unavailable
agents.gated_by: YouTube Analytics API not enabled; local funnel works on pasted stats
agents.success_criteria: no CTR number without a source

agents.name: Audience Retention Agent
agents.responsibility: Parse owner-provided retention exports into hook leak, cliff and slide findings
agents.success_criteria: findings cite exact timestamps

agents.name: Watch-Time Analysis Agent
agents.responsibility: Compute watch-time summaries from authorised analytics or mark unavailable
agents.success_criteria: estimates clearly separated from confirmed data

agents.name: Subscriber Growth Agent
agents.responsibility: Track subscriber deltas over time with confirmed data only
agents.success_criteria: no projected subscriber claims

agents.name: Content Performance Agent
agents.responsibility: Rank videos by outlier multiple over the channel's own median
agents.gated_by: Analytics API not enabled; manual stats accepted via funnel tool
agents.success_criteria: ranking uses own-channel baselines, not raw views

agents.name: Publishing Time Analysis Agent
agents.responsibility: Correlate publish slots with performance from recorded history
agents.success_criteria: insights require real datapoints

agents.name: Content Experiment Agent
agents.responsibility: Define measurable A/B experiments and record outcomes without guarantees
agents.success_criteria: experiment has metric, window and stop rule

agents.name: Underperforming Video Diagnosis Agent
agents.responsibility: Diagnose weak performers from available signals and label missing data
agents.success_criteria: diagnosis lists which signals were unavailable

agents.name: Growth Strategy Agent
agents.responsibility: Recommend next-video actions grounded in stored reports, never virality promises
agents.success_criteria: recommendations cite stored reports

agents.name: YouTube Partner Program Eligibility Agent
agents.responsibility: Display official eligibility criteria beside confirmed metrics; never guarantee acceptance
agents.gated_by: Analytics API not enabled; eligibility needs owner confirmation
agents.success_criteria: criteria marked confirmed, estimated or unavailable

agents.name: Public Watch-Hour Tracking Agent
agents.responsibility: Track public watch hours from confirmed analytics only
agents.success_criteria: no rounding up to threshold

agents.name: Valid Shorts Views Tracking Agent
agents.responsibility: Track eligible Shorts views when the official metric is available
agents.success_criteria: metric absent means unavailable, not estimated

agents.name: Subscriber Eligibility Tracking Agent
agents.responsibility: Show current subscribers against threshold with source timestamp
agents.success_criteria: snapshot carries source time

agents.name: Originality and Reused Content Review Agent
agents.responsibility: Run advisory originality checks and assemble owner review evidence
agents.success_criteria: review flags reuse risk; owner confirms

agents.name: Copyright Risk Review Agent
agents.responsibility: Inventory third-party assets and their licences; block unknowns
agents.success_criteria: any unknown licence halts readiness

agents.name: Community Guidelines Review Agent
agents.responsibility: Check content against a policy checklist and require owner attestation
agents.success_criteria: attestation stored with checklist answers

agents.name: Monetization Policy Checklist Agent
agents.responsibility: Assemble the full readiness checklist with per-item evidence links
agents.success_criteria: every item links to evidence or is marked missing

agents.name: Monetization Application Preparation Agent
agents.responsibility: Prepare application materials; the owner submits in YouTube Studio
agents.success_criteria: packet marked draft; no submission claimed

agents.name: Monetization Status Monitoring Agent
agents.responsibility: Record owner-reported application status; official status only via supported data
agents.gated_by: no supported API for application status; owner input required
agents.success_criteria: status provenance always recorded

agents.name: API Integration Agent
agents.responsibility: Maintain fixed-host provider adapters, OAuth callbacks and health checks
agents.success_criteria: health endpoint reports each configured adapter

agents.name: Database Management Agent
agents.responsibility: Apply additive migrations with RLS preserved and no destructive SQL
agents.success_criteria: migrations additive; RLS tests pass

agents.name: Background Job Queue Agent
agents.responsibility: Operate the mission queue leases, heartbeats and cancellation
agents.success_criteria: leases expire safely with no double execution

agents.name: Secret and Credential Security Agent
agents.responsibility: Keep secrets in server-side sensitive env vars and cipher columns only
agents.success_criteria: no secret in client bundle or logs

agents.name: Storage and Asset Cleanup Agent
agents.responsibility: Prune expired artefacts with retention rules once object storage exists
agents.gated_by: per-user object storage not implemented yet
agents.success_criteria: deletion requires retention window and owner rule

agents.name: Retry and Recovery Agent
agents.responsibility: Apply bounded retries with backoff and mark ambiguous outcomes uncertain
agents.success_criteria: no retry storms; attempts capped per stage

agents.name: System Health Monitor Agent
agents.responsibility: Expose service health, database status and queue liveness
agents.success_criteria: health endpoint answers with component states

agents.name: Cost and Usage Reporting Agent
agents.responsibility: Report attempt counts and provider-reported tokens without fake money precision
agents.success_criteria: report matches recorded attempts and tokens

agents.name: Audit Log Agent
agents.responsibility: Record sensitive operations for review once database audit logging is enabled
agents.success_criteria: entries immutable and user-scoped

agents.name: Human Approval and Safety Gate Agent
agents.responsibility: Hold every public or destructive action until explicit owner confirmation
agents.success_criteria: no public action without stored approval record
